newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED INTERESTED IN SEAN DUNDEE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED INTERESTED IN SEAN DUNDEE.

text.p: English champions Manchester United are interested in signing striker Sean Dundee from Bundesliga club Karlsruhe, a German newspaper reported on Tuesday.

The Bild daily said United manager Alex Ferguson watched Dundee during Karlsruhe's 2-0 defeat at home to Bayern Munich on Sunday night. The match was Dundee's first game back after an injury lay-off which had sidelined him for a month.
The South African-born forward, who was granted German citizenship last year, has scored 14 league goals for Karlsruhe this season.
